GRADE 9 AGRICULTURE — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Time: 40 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Conserving Animal Feed: Hay in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe methods of conserving forage in coping with drought,
   B. Learners should ignore Conserving Animal Feed: Hay completely.
   C. Conserving Animal Feed: Hay is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

2. About Conserving Animal Feed: Hay around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. conserve forage to cope with drought,
   B. Learners should ignore Conserving Animal Feed: Hay completely.
   C. Conserving Animal Feed: Hay is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

3. About Conserving Animal Feed: Hay in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe methods of conserving forage in coping with drought,
   B. Learners should ignore Conserving Animal Feed: Hay completely.
   C. Conserving Animal Feed: Hay is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

5. About Conserving Leftover Food in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the importance of conserving leftover food at home
   B. Learners should ignore Conserving Leftover Food completely.
   C. Conserving Leftover Food is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Conserving Leftover Food.

6. About Conserving Leftover Food around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. prepare leftover food to avoid wastage
   B. Learners should ignore Conserving Leftover Food completely.
   C. Conserving Leftover Food is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Conserving Leftover Food.

7. About Conserving Leftover Food in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the importance of conserving leftover food at home
   B. Learners should ignore Conserving Leftover Food completely.
   C. Conserving Leftover Food is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Conserving Leftover Food.

9. About Integrated Farming in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe components of integrated farming in conserving resources,
   B. Learners should ignore Integrated Farming completely.
   C. Integrated Farming is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Integrated Farming.

10. About Integrated Farming around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. make a model of integrated farming for the conservation of resources,
   B. Learners should ignore Integrated Farming completely.
   C. Integrated Farming is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Integrated Farming.

11. About Integrated Farming in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe components of integrated farming in conserving resources,
   B. Learners should ignore Integrated Farming completely.
   C. Integrated Farming is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Integrated Farming.

13. About Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix completely.
   C. Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

14. About Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix completely.
   C. Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

15. About Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix completely.
   C. Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

17. About Organic Gardening in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Organic Gardening using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Organic Gardening completely.
   C. Organic Gardening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Organic Gardening.

18. About Organic Gardening around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Organic Gardening at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Organic Gardening completely.
   C. Organic Gardening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Organic Gardening.

19. About Organic Gardening in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Organic Gardening helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Organic Gardening completely.
   C. Organic Gardening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Organic Gardening.

SECTION B: Short Answers

20. Give two examples of how you can use Organic Gardening in your school compound.
